bio: A crocodile hatchling striped yellow like a fry carton. It has already served four.
Grill marks run along its back and a bun of a hump sits on its shoulders. It has served billions and is counting.
Golden arches for jaws and a drive-through for a body. It is not in the food business, it says; it is in the land business.
note: The same in every town, on purpose.
Owns the ground under every grill.
